metadata.name: DualAuthRegistrationVerification
metadata.description: Use this API to register your card for Dual Authentication.

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked Example: 1.3 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of sender Example:  10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source from where API Call is initiated. CoreCard have multiple value of source for internal system (CoreMoney, SelfService, IVR, MobileSelfService) For external system expected source will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller Id of source from where API is initiated. It is End User phone number. Example: 7204454214 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called Id of destination for which API is initiated. It is Corecard IVR number. Example: 7314145404 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ANI
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: DNS
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Flag to retrieve error message in specific language Example: 'en' for English Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: RequestDate
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM-DD-YYYYTHH:MM:SS Example:- 11-12-2021T13:05:10 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: CardNumber
request_fields.description: Clear Card Number of the cardholder Valid values: 0-9 Example: 123456******0001 Condition: At least one of Card Number/Proxy Number is required. Allowable Values: 16

request_fields.name: ProxyNumber
request_fields.description: Proxy Number of the cardholder Valid values:0-9 Example:1005 Condition: At least one of Card Number/Proxy Number is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: DualAuthFlag
request_fields.description: Decision flag to decides whether Register/Validate/Enroll for Dual Authentication. Valid Values: 1 = Register the Dual Authentication paramters. 2 = Validate the Dual Authentication parameters. 3 = Enroll for Dual Authentication. Example: 1

request_fields.name: DateOfBirth
request_fields.description: Date of Birth of cardholder Format: MM/DD/YYYY Valid Values: 0-9 Example:- 03/26/1986 Condition : If DOB is already present  and set as one of the authenticationparameter ,then  to be entered  mandatorily. If DOB is not present and set as one of the authentication parameters, then needs to be registered mandatorily.

request_fields.name: SSNLast4Digits
request_fields.description: Last 4 digits of Social Security Number of a Cardholder Valid values :0-9 Example: 6789 Condition : If SSN is already present  and set as one of the authenticationparameter ,then  to be entered  mandatorily. If SSN is not present and set as one of the authentication parameters, then needs to be registered mandatorily. Allowable Values: 9

request_fields.name: CVCorCVV
request_fields.description: Three digit printed on  the back of  the card . Valid Values - 0-9 Example: 213 Condition : mandatory to answer if set as one of the authentication parameters. Allowable Values: 3

request_fields.name: CurrentPIN
request_fields.description: Four Digit Current PIN Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 1346 Condition : mandatory to answer if set as one of the authentication parameters. Allowable Values: 4

request_fields.name: ProfilePassword
request_fields.description: Current profile password Valid Values: A-Z, a-z,0-9, Special characters. Example: Test123! Condition : mandatory to answer if set as one of the authentication parameters. Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: IsUserEnabledinDualAuth
request_fields.description: whether user wants to enable Dual Authentication or not. Valid Values : 1 = Enable 0 = Disabled. Condition: TAG IsUserEnabledinDualAuth is mandatory only when tag DualAuthFlag = 3 and Product Field Force Opt In = No.

request_fields.name: AuthenticationCode
request_fields.description: Authentication code received by the cardholder. Condition : mandatory to answer if set as one of the authentication parameters. Allowable Values: 6

request_fields.name: Email
request_fields.description: E Mail Address of Cardholder Valid Values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 @ . Example: [email protected] Condition : mandatory to answer if set as one of the authentication parameters.

request_fields.name: MobileNumber
request_fields.description: Cardholder's Mobile Phone Number Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 9876543210 Condition : Mandatory when mobile number set as one of the dual authentication parameter.

request_fields.name: UniqueID
request_fields.description: Unique ID of Authentication Code

request_fields.name: SocialSecurityNumber
request_fields.description: Social Security Number of Cardholder Valid Values:0-9 Example:123456789 Allowable Values: 9

response_fields.name: Message
response_fields.description: Returns Error Message in case of Error.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: Returns result of API processing. If any error is found then value will be 'false' else 'true'.

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Returns Error Code in case of Error.

response_fields.name: ResponseData
response_fields.description: This is group of below data elements.
